topic: Compile-Time Polymorphism via Template Metaprogramming and its impact on Memory Layout and Performance
explanation: This explores how template metaprogramming enables compile-time polymorphism, contrasting it with runtime polymorphism achieved through virtual functions. We'll examine how compilers generate code for both, analyzing memory layout differences (virtual function tables vs. code generation per template instantiation), performance implications (runtime overhead of virtual function calls vs. compile-time optimization potential of templates), and potential pitfalls like code bloat from excessive template instantiations.  The focus will be on how the compiler handles the different mechanisms, potentially showing assembly-level differences.
keywords: C++ Templates vs Virtual Functions, Compile-time Polymorphism, Template Metaprogramming Performance, C++ Vtable Overhead
